# Spine Runtimes licenses

The Spine runtimes bundled with this plugin are Esoteric Software LLC's
and are redistributed under the Spine Runtimes License Agreement; the
exact text is included here as that license requires.

- `spine-runtimes-2019.txt` — the 2019 agreement, covering the bundled
  `spine-player@4.0` and `spine-player@4.1` builds (from the published
  npm packages, which ship this same text).
- `spine-runtimes-2025.txt` — the 2025 agreement, covering the bundled
  `spine-player@4.2` / `spine-player@4.3` builds (also the text shipped
  as `vendor/3.8/LICENSE` for the legacy 3.8 player).

Per the agreement, each user of this plugin must obtain their own Spine
Editor license to use the runtimes.

The package root also carries `LICENSE` (this plugin's MIT notice) and
`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` — the latter is generated by
`scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs` (`pnpm notices`) and lists
every bundled component.
